text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After the Satsuki Sho, Epiphaneia took 
part in several interviews leading up to 
the Japanese Derby. During one of them—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes today's interview. Thank 
you very much for giving us your valuable 
time today!
choice_data_list:
The pleasure was all mine, thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your interview, even more people 
will be paying attention to me! Thank you!
choice_data_list: こちらこそありがとうございました
choice_data_list_en: Thank you very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make this an article 
that truly touches hearts! The Derby 
feature should bring in a lot of readers, 
too!
choice_data_list: Is it really different from usual?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! The Derby is special to 
everyone, after all!
choice_data_list: やっぱり普段とは違いますか？
choice_data_list_en: Does it really feel different from usual?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just between us... I usually just treat 
most things strictly as business, but... 
when it comes to the Derby, I just can't 
help myself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume, Trainers, staff... Feeling 
everyone's passion poured into the Derby 
has moved me to tears during interviews on 
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Tears...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Epi~! You're running in the Derby, right? 
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll show you a glorious 
victory that'll make you believe in 
destiny!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, there you go saying that 
again... ...*Sigh*, I really wanted to 
race too~!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you can't run, so it 
can't be helped! ...You're seriously 
amazing, you know! Seriously... give it 
your all!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――For you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ohh! What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"My favorite water―― Ordered... from 
overseas."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I lost. However—if it's you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Good luck in the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Derby was a given to me. After 
all, I'm "me"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the Derby is such an incredible 
race... that even taking on the challenge 
is something special.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You said before that you looked up to 
them, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I still remember the sparkle in your eyes 
the day we watched the Derby together.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is special to everyone. And that 
includes you...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You want to... become a Derby Trainer, 
don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...... I've got it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. This year, you're going to 
become a Derby Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And I, too... will become everyone's sun!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that, I'll even put up with 
it! —I'm counting on your guidance!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, Epiphaneia will undergo 
training to suppress his fighting spirit. 
—Defying the voice of destiny.
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a great time today!" "Let's 
all hype Epi up!" "Yeah, yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, bring it on with everything you've 
got!! Until my passion burns bright red!"
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first training I suggested to rein in 
her fighting spirit was running alongside 
many other Umamusume. An intentional 
effort to suppress it right when the urge 
to fight surges.
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします！
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, now! I want to move up now! No, 
I'm going!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—No, stop!! Voice, please, shut up! Right 
now, I have to watch her back—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "—No, let's do this! Uwooooooooh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, treadmill work to strictly maintain 
the same pace. It's training to ensure 
your run isn't disrupted, no matter the 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No problem! There's nothing I can't do!!
choice_data_list: 地味でキツいと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Guuugh...! I hate this training! I wanna 
run more freely! The voice says so too!
choice_data_list: You have to hold back, Epi...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Hold back? There's no way... I could 
ever—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—I can do it! I'll endure it!! There's 
nothing... I can't do!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia shook her head, enduring it. 
Resisting that voice pushing her forward 
must be far harder than I could ever 
imagine...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, hold it in! Hold it, hold it, hold 
it, hold it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Thanks in part to her strong, unyielding 
willpower... she has gradually learned how 
to hold her pace back."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Tomorrow's finally the day, huh...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! How do you even get nervous 
anyway!?
choice_data_list: さすがのエピも緊張してるのか？
さすがのエピも緊張してる？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Epiphaneia really gave it her 
all. It would be amazing if she could head 
into the race with this exact momentum.
choice_data_list: うん、貴方はそれでいいよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're fine just the way you are.
Yeah, you're fine just as you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters is longer than anything so 
far, but if I hold back, I'll have enough 
energy left to accelerate in the final 
stretch. If I do that—I can give it my all 
and win!
choice_data_list: Thank you for believing in me.
Thank you for believing in me

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No thanks needed! I'm the one who decided 
to do this!
choice_data_list: 俺を信じてくれて、ありがとう
私を信じてくれて、ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for believing in me.
Thank you for believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell you the truth, when I chose to 
believe in you, I didn't hear any voice of 
destiny."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure the cheers will bless me 
too! They're bound to give me the push in 
the back I need right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, tomorrow's gonna be incredible! 
I'll win, and bestow destiny upon 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—And you're going to become a Derby 
Trainer. Just wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Fervor. —Will it be born? Or 
perhaps...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roar of the crowd reaches all the way 
over here. Everyone is waiting eagerly for 
the start of the glorious Japan Derby.
choice_data_list:
(It's completely different when you're on 
the receiving end—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As nervousness begins to seep in, I snap 
myself back into focus. If she notices, 
she'll end up encouraging me again. Today, 
that's supposed to be—my role.
choice_data_list: （受ける側になると、全然違う――）
choice_data_list_en: (Being on the receiving end feels completely different――)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: 君は頑張った、君は絶対大丈夫
貴方は頑張った、貴方は絶対大丈夫
choice_data_list_en: You worked hard. You're going to be totally fine.
You did your best. You're definitely going to be fine.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll win this! And then...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Clad in the light of the sun, I shall 
become all of destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —...*inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's fine! —Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (O-O-O-O-O-O-OH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Epiphaneiaaa!!" "Logotype!!" "Please 
win!" "Who will become the Derby 
Umamusume!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Epi~~, do your best!" "Make us feel—that 
sense of destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Win..." "I'm going to win!!" "I won't 
give it up!" "Because—" "The Derby!" "The 
Derby!" "The Derby!!"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...If I win at the Derby. I can pass the 
torch on... for all eternity..."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: The one who wins... is me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —No. The one who will win is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I want to win...――

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Win...—

text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text: (Y O U M U S T W I N ! !)
